verses.kjv: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.modern: From Paul, and Silas, and Timothy — to the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

verses.kjv: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.modern: Grace and peace to You from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;
verses.modern: We are bound to thank God always for You, brethren, as it is fitting, because Your faith is growing greatly, and the charity of every one of you toward each other is increasing.

verses.kjv: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:
verses.modern: So we ourselves boast about You among the churches of God — about Your patience and Your faith in all the persecutions and tribulations that You endure.

verses.kjv: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:
verses.modern: This is a clear sign of the righteous judgment of God — that You may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which You are also suffering.

verses.kjv: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;
verses.modern: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay with tribulation those who trouble You,

verses.kjv: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,
verses.modern: and to give You who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with His mighty angels,

verses.kjv: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.modern: in flaming fire, taking vengeance on those who do not know God, and who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;
verses.modern: They shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of His power,

verses.kjv: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.
verses.modern: when He shall come to be glorified in His saints, and to be admired by all those who believe — because our testimony among You was believed — in that day.

verses.kjv: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:
verses.modern: Therefore we also pray always for You, that our God would count You worthy of this calling, and would fulfill in You every good pleasure of His goodness and the work of faith with power,

verses.kjv: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.modern: so that the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in You, and You in Him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

chapters.summary: Paul gives thanks for the growing faith and love of the Thessalonians amid persecution, and assures them that God will repay with tribulation those who trouble them. He declares that the Lord Jesus will be revealed from heaven with His mighty angels in flaming fire, taking vengeance on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel.

verses.kjv: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,
verses.modern: Now we appeal to You, brethren, regarding the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and our being gathered together to Him:

verses.kjv: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.
verses.modern: do not be quickly shaken in mind or troubled — not by any spirit, nor by any word, nor by any letter supposedly from us — claiming that the day of Christ has already come.

verses.kjv: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
verses.modern: Let no man deceive You by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition —

verses.kjv: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.
verses.modern: He opposes and exalts Himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped — so that He, as God, sits in the temple of God, showing Himself that He is God.

verses.kjv: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
verses.modern: Do You not remember that when I was still with You, I told You these things?

verses.kjv: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.
verses.modern: And now You know what is holding Him back, so that He may be revealed in His own time.

verses.kjv: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
verses.modern: For the mystery of iniquity is already at work; only He who now restrains will restrain, until he be taken out of the way.

verses.kjv: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
verses.modern: And then shall that Wicked one be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of His mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of His coming —

verses.kjv: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
verses.modern: the one whose coming is according to the working of Satan, with all power and signs and lying wonders,

verses.kjv: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
verses.modern: and with all the deception of unrighteousness in those who perish, because they did not receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

verses.kjv: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:
verses.modern: For this cause God shall send them strong delusion, so that they will believe the lie,

verses.kjv: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
verses.modern: so that they all may be damned who did not believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

verses.kjv: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
verses.modern: But we are bound to give thanks always to God for You, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God has from the beginning chosen You to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth —

verses.kjv: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.modern: to which He called You by our gospel, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.
verses.modern: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold to the traditions which You have been taught, whether by word or by our letter.

verses.kjv: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
verses.modern: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself, and God our Father, who has loved us and given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

verses.kjv: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.
verses.modern: comfort Your hearts, and establish You in every good word and work.

chapters.summary: Paul urges the Thessalonians not to be troubled by claims that the day of Christ has already come, for that day will not come unless there is a falling away first and the man of sin is revealed, the son of perdition, who exalts himself above all that is called God. He reminds them that the mystery of iniquity is already at work, but the Lord shall consume the wicked one with the spirit of His mouth at His coming.

verses.kjv: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:
verses.modern: Finally, brethren, pray for us — that the word of the Lord may run freely and be glorified, even as it is with you,

verses.kjv: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.
verses.modern: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men; for not all men have faith.

verses.kjv: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
verses.modern: But the Lord is faithful; He will establish you and keep you from evil.

verses.kjv: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.
verses.modern: And we have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things which we command you.

verses.kjv: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.
verses.modern: May the Lord direct Your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.

verses.kjv: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.
verses.modern: Now we command You, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ: withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks disorderly, and not according to the tradition which He received from us.

verses.kjv: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
verses.modern: For You yourselves know how You ought to follow our example, for we did not behave ourselves disorderly among You,

verses.kjv: Neither did we eat any man's bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
verses.modern: nor did we eat any man's bread without paying for it; instead we worked with labor and toil night and day, so that we would not be a burden to any of You.

verses.kjv: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.
verses.modern: Not because we did not have the right, but to make ourselves an example for You to follow.

verses.kjv: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.
verses.modern: For even when we were with You, this we commanded You: if any would not work, neither should He eat.

verses.kjv: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.
verses.modern: For we hear that there are some who walk among You disorderly — not working at all, but busybodies.

verses.kjv: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
verses.modern: Now those who are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ — work quietly, and eat Your own bread.

verses.kjv: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
verses.modern: But You, brethren, do not grow weary in well doing.

verses.kjv: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.
verses.modern: And if any man does not obey our word in this letter, take note of that man, and have no company with him, so that he may be ashamed.

verses.kjv: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
verses.modern: Yet do not count Him as an enemy, but admonish Him as a brother.

verses.kjv: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.
verses.modern: Now may the Lord of peace Himself give You peace always, by every means. The Lord be with You all.

verses.kjv: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
verses.modern: The greeting is from Paul, by my own hand, which is the sign in every epistle of mine — this is how I write.

verses.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.modern: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with You all. Amen.

chapters.summary: Paul asks for prayer that the word of the Lord may spread freely and commands the church to withdraw from every brother who walks disorderly. He reminds them that he worked night and day so as not to be a burden, and declares that if any man will not work, neither should he eat.
